profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Product Engineer | Building 0-to-1 Products | Cloud, Developer Tools & Game Development | ’19 Hack.Diversity Alum
profile.summary:
I'm a product-focused full-stack software engineer and game developer with strong experience in React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, and cloud deployments. I enjoy building software products from 0 to 1, turning ideas into working applications for end users, businesses, and developers. Across different projects, I've taken ownership of technology selection, software architecture, implementation, and end-to-end product delivery.

My professional experience includes architecting and building a visual desktop editor at Soft Dynamic that enabled non-technical users to create interactive simulations without writing code, developing and redesigning an enterprise React/Redux CMS at BitReel, creating automated testing tools in Go at Carbon Black, and delivering full-stack solutions through project-based freelance work.

Beyond web development, I've also built mobile applications, games, and open-source developer tools. I enjoy exploring new technologies and choosing the right tools for each project.


-- HOW I GOT HERE --

I've been involved with technology since I was around eight years old, helping maintain computers at my mother's internet café. That early exposure led me to experiment with websites, programming, and game development, driven by a desire to create my own versions of the digital experiences I enjoyed.

I later received formal training in business software development, databases, and networking at ITESA, a technical high school, building console-based business systems with C++ and desktop applications with C# WinForms and Java Swing. At ITLA, I continued with server-side web development using Java/Spring, C#/ASP.NET, and PHP/CodeIgniter. Throughout my studies and professional career, I've continued teaching myself new languages, frameworks, game engines, cloud platforms, and development tools.

Game development originally inspired me to learn programming, and that passion for creating software continues to drive my work today.

I'm interested in opportunities involving full-stack engineering, product development, cloud platforms, developer tooling, and game development.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project-based freelance collaboration focused on developing full-stack client solutions, business applications, and early-stage products. My work includes requirements, architecture, frontend and backend development, deployment, debugging, and iteration.

• Designed and prototyped an early-stage multi-tenant SaaS application using Astro, TypeScript, and Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, and KV, including SVG and font workflows structured for future AI-assisted processing.
• Developed custom WordPress functionality using PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript, including admin CRUD workflows, custom database tables, AJAX actions, and gated content downloads.
• Built and deployed a production healthcare staffing website using Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Cloudflare Pages, with Git-based continuous deployment, responsive design, SEO, and DNS/SSL configuration.
positions.insights: Skills: Astro · GitHub · PostgreSQL · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · C# · Cloudflare · Generative AI · JavaScript · Go (Programming Language) · Express.js · React.js · Automation · REST APIs · Node.js · Tailwind CSS · TypeScript · Flutter

positions.title: Information Security Support Engineer
positions.description:
Supported IT and information security operations in a HealthTech environment handling sensitive DNA and biometric data, helping maintain secure access, endpoint protection, and internal security practices aligned with HIPAA and SOC 2 requirements.

• Managed Identity and Access Management (IAM), account provisioning, and MFA/2FA across internal platforms, including HubSpot, Confluence, and company intranet systems.
• Monitored and managed endpoint security through the ESET administration console, supporting antivirus protection, device security, and issue resolution across macOS and Windows environments.
• Supported employee onboarding by configuring accounts, VPN access, security settings, and email signatures while explaining internal security policies and procedures.
• Troubleshot access, VPN, endpoint, and infrastructure issues, managing support requests through Jira and collaborating with Security and DevOps teams.
• Maintained internal documentation and knowledge-base resources supporting employee onboarding, security procedures, and IT operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) · Information Security · SOC 2 · Confluence · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · Endpoint Security · Twilio · Network Security · Microsoft Azure · Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

positions.title: XR Software Engineer
positions.description:
Joined an early-stage startup as an XR Software Engineer and expanded into React/Redux CMS development, implementing a redesigned frontend based on provided UI designs and integrating the application with an existing Python REST API.

• Developed and modernized frontend features for an enterprise React/Redux CMS, implementing updated interfaces, navigation, and workflows for managing complex 3D assets.
• Integrated the React frontend with an existing Python REST API using Axios, supporting application data synchronization and CMS functionality.
• Supported the migration of 3D viewer workflows from Three.js to Babylon.js, improving the React-based viewer's WebXR integration and cross-platform stability.
• Optimized React component rendering and Redux state management, troubleshooting performance bottlenecks and frontend usability issues in data-heavy XR workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: WebGL · WebXR · Three.js · JavaScript · Redux.js · React.js · REST APIs · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
• Selected into the 8-month Hack.Diversity Fellowship, a workforce development and leadership program focused on advancing people of color into high-impact tech roles. The program integrates Boston’s innovation, civic, academic, corporate, and philanthropic communities.
• Completed a series of five IDEO CoLab design-thinking workshops to explore and propose technology-driven solutions addressing challenges at the intersection of skill access and the future of work.
• Collaborated with a team of five to develop a prototype educational app that helps high school students learn programming fundamentals using diagrams, algorithms, and JavaScript-based code.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Structures · Design Thinking · JavaScript · Software Engineering Practices

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern (via Hack.Diversity)
positions.description:
Developed internal developer tooling and automated testing solutions in Go for endpoint security systems, supporting the validation of operating system behavior and endpoint telemetry.

• Built an automated Go testing framework running in isolated macOS virtual machines to simulate file-system and operating-system behavior and validate endpoint-security telemetry.
• Automated cross-environment testing workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Docker, VMware, and CentOS, supporting testing across endpoint sensors, host operating systems, and cloud analysis components.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Gitlab · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Go (Programming Language) · C (Programming Language) · CentOS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed interactive applications and game prototypes using Unity and C#, collaborating with designers and artists to implement gameplay systems and refine user experiences.

• Developed gameplay mechanics, interactive behaviors, and reusable systems using Unity and C#.
• Integrated visual assets, animations, and gameplay logic, debugging interactions and optimizing performance for mobile devices.
• Contributed to Witchpires, a 2D top-down shooter, collaborating with the team on gameplay implementation and improvements based on prototype feedback.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity3D · C# · Software Engineering Practices · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Android

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and developed a visual desktop editor using Electron, React, JavaScript, Node.js, and PhaserJS, enabling non-technical teams to create interactive industrial and HR training simulations without writing code.

• Developed a drag-and-drop 2D scene editor with a Unity-inspired animation timeline and predefined controls for text, movement, animation sequences, and scene transitions.
• Built project parsing and code-generation functionality that converted visual editor configurations into PhaserJS project files.
• Implemented functionality for loading, editing, and regenerating existing PhaserJS projects through the desktop editor.
positions.insights: Skills: Phaser JS · Gitlab · JavaScript · React.js · Node.js · Electron.js

positions.title: IT Infrastructure Intern
positions.description:
Provided foundational IT infrastructure support and system administration for internal staff, focusing on hardware diagnostics and network connectivity.

• Assembled, diagnosed, and repaired enterprise PC hardware, conducting rigorous component-level testing to ensure system stability.
• Provisioned local workstations, executing OS formatting, installations, and secure data backups for organizational use.
• Configured local network settings and integrated machines into the corporate intranet, ensuring secure and reliable internal connectivity.
• Logged and resolved technical service requests, maintaining hardware and software functionality across the IT department.
positions.insights: Skills: Information Technology · Computer Hardware · Troubleshooting · Network Configuration · Technical Support · Computer Networking · System Administration

projects.title: Aseprite Slice Exporter (Lua Extension) | GitHub
projects.description: Built a Lua-based Aseprite extension to batch export all slices into individual PNGs while preserving slice bounds and names, reducing manual exports and improving consistency for spritesheets, tilesets, and UI assets.

projects.title: VR Crane Training Simulator | XR Terra × Packet39
projects.description:
Contributed to a team-built VR crane training simulator prototype during XR Terra's AR & VR Developer Program, in collaboration with Packet39.

Developed using Unity and C#, the prototype explored VR-based crane operator training through interactive controls, physics-based load handling, guided practice, scoring, and bilingual support.
